mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.2 million units per month signals strong household demand and confidence, which translates into higher corporate earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1200.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100.0 index level signals weakening real economic activity, which reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures and residential construction starts signals broad-based demand strength, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI and a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that delay rate cuts, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS are rising, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls signals a labor market that is both tight and expanding, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures above 24000 billion dollars, combined with rising residential construction starts, signals strong consumer demand and confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are above their 12-month moving averages, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
